title: Mardi Gras work with Harry Robichaud
summary: Talk of Harry Robichaud, and Alexander says he has played with him on Mardi Gras day for seven years, for carnival club dances.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: You say you've been working with Robichaud over there for... Harry Robichaud. Harry Robichaud. Is he the banjo player? Who? Harry Robichaud. Harry Robichaud, guitar player. Yeah, you know him? Yeah, I've heard him. I met him one time. Yeah. He's related to shots, wasn't he?
Yeah, I've been playing with him on that day, you know, for the last seven years.
Yeah. Remember the carnival clubs, these Mardi Gras, they have a dance every year. That's the two sisters?
